heading_mode.label: Heading style
heading_mode.info: Choose how the section heading is rendered.

fallback_heading.label: Heading when fallback (latest posts) is shown

heading_size.label: Heading size
heading_size.info: Use Theme default to inherit the theme's heading styles. Choose a size only when you need to override it.

container_mode.label: Section width
container_mode.info: Use a theme wrapper when possible. Choose Custom max width only when the theme wrappers do not fit this section.

custom_max_width.label: Custom max width
custom_max_width.info: Used only when Section width is Custom max width.

tax.label: Taxonomy (WordPress)
tax.info: Choose whether the matching term should be compared with WordPress categories or tags.

term_source.label: Store term source
term_source.info: The selected store value is normalized and matched against the chosen WordPress category or tag. Product metafield custom.content_bridge overrides this source when set.

term_custom.label: Custom term
term_custom.info: Used only when Store term source is Custom term.

term_minlen.label: Minimum term length (optional)
term_minlen.info: If term length is less than this value, it will be treated as invalid.

fallback_latest.label: If filtered posts are empty, show latest posts instead
